text: いまじゃ　みる　かげも　ないがね！

structure.jp: みる　かげも　ないがね！
structure.en: he's a mere shadow of what he was, though!

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: Here じゃ is not 'it is' but a short spoken form of では, which sets now against before. いまじゃ = 'these days, as for now'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence means 'but' or 'though', left hanging. みる　かげも　ないがね = 'though there's no trace of that left, you know'.
